description: This tool enables you to search and retrieve high-precision metadata for oriented (directional) aerial or satellite images available over a specific area. include.description:
Selects which metadata fields appear in the output payload. Allowed values:

Layer related fields:
     -layer: returns the name of the layer.

Oriented Image related fields:
     -image-name: returns the name of the image.
     -original-image-name: returns the image's unique name prior to post-processing, may be different that "image-name".
     -original-shot-id: returns the image's unique identifier within the context of its flight mission.
     -image-center: returns the point representing the geographical center of the image, in wkt format and EPSG:4326 reference system.
     -geometry: returns the image footprint, in wkt format and EPSG:4326 reference system.
     -capture-date: returns the date the image was captured.
     -camera-pos-x: returns the easting coordinate of the location of the camera sensor at the time of image capture.
     -camera-pos-y: returns the northing coordinate of the location of the camera sensor at the time of image capture.
     -camera-pos-z: returns the height of the location of the camera sensor at the time of image capture. In meters above orthometric sea level.
     -ground-z: returns the elevation of the ground surface directly below the camera's location at the time of image capture.
     -omega: returns the rotation of the camera around its x-axis axis in radians - represents tilt.
     -phi: returns the rotation of the camera around its y-axis axis in radians - represents tilt.
     -kappa: returns the rotation of the camera around its optical axis in radians - represents roll.
     -flight-line-id: returns the numeric identifier assigned to the flight line, used to reference its role within the collection’s image capture strategy.

Event related fields:
     -graysky-event: returns the name of the graysky-event associated to the image.

Collection related fields:
     -collection: returns the name of the collection associated to the image.
     -pretty-name: returns the name of the collection associated to the image, formatted for display or print purposes, may be different to "collection".
     -capture-year: returns the 4-digit year in which the target collection associated to the image was captured, in ISO 8601 format.
     -first-capture-date: returns the date of capture of the first image within the collection associated to the target image.
     -last-capture-date: returns the date of capture of the last image within the collection associated to the target image.

Coverage related fields:
     -min-gsd: returns the minimum ground sample distance (gsd) found within the image.
     -max-gsd: returns the maximum ground sample distance (gsd) found within the image.
     -min-gsd: returns the average ground sample distance (gsd) found within the image.
     -area: returns the area of the target image's footprint on the ground, in square kilometers.
     -z-index: defines the suggested drawing order for overlapping images. Higher values are more recent.
     -first-publish-date: returns the date of the earliest publication of the collection associated to the image.
     -last-publish-date: returns the date of the latest publication of the collection associated to the image.
     -max-zoom: returns the maximum supported zoom level for the tiles within the collection.
     -product-type: returns the camera-axis and/or cardinal direction of the image.

Utm zone related fields:
     -utm-zone: returns the UTM zone in which the imagery is located.

Camera related fields:
     -camera-technology: returns the make, model and version of the camera hardware.
     -focal-length: returns the focal length of the collection camera in millimeters.
     -pp0-x: returns the horizontal offset of the principal point from the image's geometric center.
     -pp0-y: returns the vertical offset of the principal point from the image's geometric center.
     -k0: returns the zeroth-order radial distortion coefficient used to represent the constant radial bias in the image.
     -k1: returns the first-order radial distortion coefficient used to correct for "barrel" (negative k1) or "pincushion" (positive k1) distortion in the image.
     -k2: returns second-order radial distortion coefficient used to refine the curve of distortion in the image.
     -k3: returns the third-order radial distortion coefficient used to fine-tune the edges of the image where distortion is the strongest.
     -p1: returns the tangential distortion coefficient along the x-axis representing horizontal skew corrections due to lens decentering.
     -p2: returns the tangential distortion coefficient along the y-axis representing vertical skew corrections due to lens decentering.
     -b1: returns the affine (non-orthogonal) distortion coefficient along the x axis accounting for scaling/skew distortions in which pixels do not form perfect squares.
     -b2: returns the affine (non-orthogonal) distortion coefficient along the y axis accounting for scaling/skew distortions in which pixels do not form perfect squares.
     -raster-size-width: returns the number of pixel columns in the image, measured horizontally.
     -raster-size-height: returns the number of pixel rows in the image, measured vertically.
     -pixel-size: returns a camera parameter showing the width of a single pixel on the sensor in millimeters.

Computed in runtime related fields:
     -relation-polygon-in-image: returns the percentage of the image that the wkt polygon covers.
     -relation-polygon-in-polygon: returns the percentage of the wkt polygon that is covered by imagery.
